lines.text: Moses gathers Israel and says the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, with no fires in dwellings.
Moses tells everyone with a willing heart to bring gold, silver, and bronze, and skilled craftsmen to make everything.
Men and women with willing hearts bring gold jewelry, and the judges bring onyx stones and gemstones.
The LORD calls Bezalel of Judah and gives him and Oholiab of Levi the ability to teach.
The people keep bringing offerings morning after morning until the craftsmen say they have more than enough.
